notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Coretapper.
Coretapper does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Coretapper.
Repeat from step 1 one additional time.
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
